replies.author: vladthegreat100
replies.body: More Land Less air. Avicade can carry I believe 30 or 40 people. Imagine all of those people running around. They would be falling off since they wouldn't be able to see. But not as big as me and Porky's red alert map that we did (was huge) probably got denied since it would take a lot of time for people to fall.
